description: Update one node, including nested settings through fields. Objects merge recursively so sibling settings survive; arrays replace. Use update_asset_set_plan for manifest items. Run validate_asset_flow afterwards.

fields.description: Nested node payload fields, in camelCase or snake_case. Objects merge, arrays replace, null clears. Use this for generate.target, assetSetSettings, process configs and exportPolicy. Do not include the node-kind wrapper. Manifest items require update_asset_set_plan.

nodeId.description: Node id in the stored graph — from get_asset_flow.

sessionId.description: Persisted flow session id (flow_session_…) from create_asset_flow or list_asset_flows.

name: update_flow_node
